title: Sorting by Date orders customers by their most recent invoice date even though the Date cell is blank on customer rows
custom_preconds: 1. Two customers exist whose most recent invoice dates differ clearly (seed ZZAUTOTEST invoices on different dates).
custom_steps:
1. Click the Date column header.
2. Compare the customer order with each customer's most recent invoice date (expand to check the invoice dates).
custom_expected:
1. Customer rows order by each customer's most recent invoice date in the current view.
2. The Date cells on customer rows stay blank — the sort still works.
